x: Joe Colman is in hospital undergoing a leg operation and we wish him well. Stanley Manning of our walking teams of the 1920's and a one time holder of the Norwich to Ipswich record has been in ill-health lately but hopes to call in at Wimbledon during the Winter season.
Joe Colman was third in the A.A.A. Seven Miles and third in the Southern Two Miles' Walk.
